dedupe_keys.name: travel times to hospitals in australia

description: Travel times to hospitals in Australia is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sebastiano Barbieri et al. Travel time to hospital is a key measure of health service accessibility, and impacts patients’ experiences of care and health outcomes. Methods used to estimate travel time vary across studies. Coverage: national (AU); published in 2019. Formats: CSV, Pickle. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC BY 4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
